name: loadforge
description: Auto-scaling playground: Next.js dashboard, NestJS Watcher and Defender on AWS EC2

scripts.dev: concurrently -n defender,watcher,dashboard -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run start:dev -w @loadforge/defender" "npm run start:dev -w @loadforge/watcher" "npm run dev -w @loadforge/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @loadforge/defender && npm run build -w @loadforge/watcher && npm run build -w @loadforge/dashboard
